title: Worktop Compare:
an instant price
calculator in a month
slides.subtitle: An earlier version we built for a client generated £7m worth of leads in 11 months.

slides.label: The old way
slides.detail: Email a floor plan. Wait. Book a site visit just to get a number. Then repeat with two more suppliers to check the first price was fair.
slides.start: Count how many hours a week you spend on quotes that never turn into work.

slides.label: Why it matters
slides.detail: 41% of UK home improvement jobs cost more than the original quote, by £1,325 on average (Checkatrade, 2026). 36% of those homeowners had priced the job from online research.
slides.start: People already price online. Give them a realistic number to find.

slides.label: Piece 1: an instant price
slides.detail: A homeowner answers a few questions about their kitchen and the worktop they want, and gets an indication of the cost straight away. No plans to email, no visit for a ballpark.
slides.start: Write down the four or five things that really drive your price.

slides.label: Piece 2: the right suppliers
slides.detail: With a figure in hand, the homeowner is matched to suitable suppliers who can give the best value. Suppliers get warm leads from people who have already seen a real number.
slides.start: Decide what happens after the price: a call, a booking or a match.

slides.label: The tools
slides.detail: Claude, Lovable, Supabase, Apify and ChatGPT. Built in one month, no development team.
slides.start: Describe your calculator in plain English to an AI app builder and test it on five past jobs.

slides.label: What the earlier version did
slides.detail: The calculator we built before this one, for a client, generated £7m worth of leads in 11 months. That is lead value, not sales, and your results will differ.
slides.start: Answer "how much would it be?" instantly and more people get in touch.

title: £7m in leads.
Now rebuilt in a month.
slides.body: Worktop Compare is not live yet. Any business that quotes for work could use the same idea.
slides.cta: What would your customers want priced instantly? Tell us in the comments.
